work.composition: wide horizontal panorama, all-over target field
work.description: Dense accumulation of collaged elements—concentric target rings, compact discs, chess pieces, skateboards, and printed text fragments—distributed across a white ground overlaid with red and yellow geometric grid lines. Circular motifs in black, red, yellow, and blue recur at varied scales throughout the composition, interspersed with schematic drawings and handwritten inscriptions.
work.title: Untitled (Skateboards on Target Field)
